source: C.D.Pruitt, R.J.Charity, et al., Physical Review, Part C, Nuclear Physics 102, 034601 (2020);  Data taken from the EXFOR database, file EXFOR 14661001 dated 2020, retrieved from the IAEA Nuclear Data Services website.
